De grootste uitdaging was de locatie zel: The biggest challenge was the venue itself. The gym was on the first floor, so all the equipment was unloaded at the back in a field and carried up from there.
De grootste uitdaging was de tent elke d: The biggest challenge was transforming the tent into a new experience every day. The best moment? LaFuente, who didn't want to stop and launched into Ratata ten times or so.
De grootste uitdaging zat boven ons hoof: The biggest challenge was above our heads. Each tent frame could carry at most 100 kilos, and with show lighting you hit that fast. We chose four six-metre ladder trusses with lightweight fixtures, including the Showtec Shark The Meg Beam One and the Showtec Stage Blinder FLEX Blaze. That put a serious amount of light in the roof, for a fraction of the weight.
